name: qsv
description: Ultra-fast CSV data processing toolkit with 50+ commands and Python integration

tools.description: Ultra-fast CSV toolkit with 50+ commands for data processing
tools.usage:
qsv stats data.csv # Generate statistics
qsv select 1,3,5 data.csv # Select columns
qsv filter 'age > 30' data.csv # Filter rows
qsv join id file1.csv file2.csv # Join files
qsv frequency column data.csv # Value frequency count

tools.description: QSV DataPusher version with enhanced data uploading and API integration capabilities
tools.usage:
qsvdp upload data.csv --api-endpoint https://api.example.com # Upload CSV to API
qsvdp validate schema.json data.csv # Validate against schema
qsvdp transform rules.json data.csv # Apply transformations

tools.description: Lightweight version of QSV with core functionality for basic CSV operations
tools.usage:
qsvlite stats data.csv # Basic statistics
qsvlite select 1,3 data.csv # Select columns
qsvlite headers data.csv # Show headers
qsvlite count data.csv # Row count

tools.description: Nightly development build of QSV Lite with latest experimental features
tools.usage:
qsvlite_nightly stats --experimental data.csv # Use experimental features
qsvlite_nightly beta-command data.csv # Try beta functionality
qsvlite_nightly --version # Show nightly version info

tools.description: QSV Pro version with advanced analytics and enterprise features
tools.usage:
qsvp analyze --advanced data.csv # Advanced analytics
qsvp ml-predict model.json data.csv # Machine learning predictions
qsvp enterprise-export data.csv # Enterprise format export

tools.description: QSV Pro DataPusher combining enterprise features with API integration
tools.usage:
qsvpdp enterprise-upload data.csv --secure-api https://enterprise.api.com # Secure enterprise upload
qsvpdp audit-trail data.csv # Generate audit trail
qsvpdp compliance-check data.csv # Compliance validation

tools.description: QSV Pro Lite version with balanced features and performance
tools.usage:
qsvplite pro-stats data.csv # Professional statistics
qsvplite advanced-join file1.csv file2.csv # Advanced join operations
qsvplite optimize data.csv # Performance optimizations

tools.description: QSV with embedded Python 3.10 for advanced data processing and scripting
tools.usage:
qsvpy310 py 'df.describe()' data.csv # Python pandas operations
qsvpy310 script analysis.py data.csv # Run Python script
qsvpy310 py 'import numpy; df.mean()' data.csv # NumPy operations

tools.description: QSV with embedded Python 3.11 offering improved performance for data science workflows
tools.usage:
qsvpy311 py 'df.groupby("category").sum()' data.csv # Group operations
qsvpy311 ml-train model.py data.csv # Machine learning training
qsvpy311 py 'df.plot()' data.csv # Data visualization

tools.description: QSV with embedded Python 3.12 featuring latest Python optimizations and syntax
tools.usage:
qsvpy312 py 'match df.shape[0]: case n if n > 1000: print("Large dataset")' data.csv # Pattern matching
qsvpy312 py 'df.query("age > @threshold")' data.csv # Enhanced querying
qsvpy312 async-process data.csv # Async operations

tools.description: QSV with embedded Python 3.13 beta featuring cutting-edge Python developments
tools.usage:
qsvpy313 py --experimental 'df.new_feature()' data.csv # Experimental Python features
qsvpy313 py 'df.enhanced_typing()' data.csv # Advanced type hints
qsvpy313 beta-analysis data.csv # Beta analysis features

tools.description: Nightly development build of QSV with latest features and experimental commands
tools.usage:
qsv_nightly experimental-command data.csv # Try experimental features
qsv_nightly beta-stats data.csv # Beta statistical functions
qsv_nightly --nightly-info # Show nightly build information
qsv_nightly bleeding-edge data.csv # Latest bleeding-edge features
